title: 第一章 死神塔第二章 筑基四层
content_zh:
第一章：死神塔如梦初醒，苏命猛地瞪大眼睛，双目猩红。
眼前，是一间古香古色的房间，自己正躺在一张奢华大床上，手脚无力，无法动弹。
床地咯吱作响，两道人影在一旁忘我的交错，丝毫没有注意到，一旁的少年已经睁开了双眼！
“我还活着？我不是死了吗？”
他叫苏命，赤阳神朝第一神皇。外出探寻神秘至宝死神塔时，被自己最好的兄弟林战偷袭而亡。
下一刻，一股不属于自己的记忆猛地涌入脑海，伴随着脑海撕裂般的剧痛，融合记忆的苏命终于明白了一切。
他重生了！
重生在了一个同样名为苏命的少年身上。
苏命，潜龙城苏家大少爷，但自小身体孱弱。
十八岁因意外瘫痪，从此幽居在后院，其起居住行都只能靠自己的侍女和侍卫。
但苏家估计怎么也不会想到，照顾苏命的侍女和侍卫胆大包天。
为了偷情，嫌原主碍事的二人居然给原主下了过量的迷药，最终致其死亡。
……
床帏摇晃，一旁的男子狠狠哆嗦，随后像软脚虾一样趴在了女子肚皮之上。
“你轻一点，一会儿再把这废物给吵醒了！”
“小宝贝，你怕什么，他被咱们下了迷魂散，三四天内都醒不过来。放心。”
“你真坏……”
“可你不就喜欢我这样吗？”
“讨厌！”
娇声艳语中，两人相依着沉沉睡去……

一旁，苏命冷冷看着这一切，心中漠然：
“说起来你我也算同是天涯沦落人，不过既然我借你的身体复活，那你的仇、我的仇，就都由我来报吧。”
有了打算，但现在的苏命却没有报仇的能力。只能闭上眼睛查看起这具身体。
片刻后，苏命无奈地摇了摇头：
“肉体虚弱、经脉纤细、体内杂质无数，也难怪二十岁还在筑基境一重。”
天元大陆以修行为尊，境界分别为：筑基、气海、金丹、天门、天王、皇者、神皇等境界，而这些境界每一层又都分为九重。
苏命十岁开始修炼，二十岁才堪堪筑基一层，可想而知这速度究竟有多慢。
苏命继续查看，下一刻却是眉头一皱：
“怎么回事……”
内视之下，只见腿部的经脉之中居然出现了一片一片的乌黑。
“居然是毒素？”
苏命眉头越皱越深，他就说原主哪怕再弱，也不至于忽然就瘫痪了，原来居然是中毒的原因。
不过此刻的苏命根本没有时间思考谁是真凶，当务之急还是先解毒，然后重新修炼。
在这个弱肉强食的世界，没有修为，想做任何事情都是虚妄。
正在此时，他忽然感觉到丹田之处传出一股暖流。
暖流所过之处，不仅经脉强度得到加强，就连毒素也被瞬间带走。
顺着暖流溯源而上，只见丹田之内，一尊造型古朴的黑色小塔悬浮其中。
“死神塔？！”
苏命一眼就认出，眼前这尊小塔，正是前世临死前遇到的死神塔。但不知道什么原因，死神塔居然跟着自己一同重生了。
苏命还在沉思，眼前的黑色小塔忽然传来一道刺目的乌光。

光芒闪烁，苏命只感觉脑海一阵天旋地转，随后，他的意识便出现在了一片奇异的空间内。
这是一片浩瀚的星海，数不尽的星辰汇聚在一起，密密麻麻占满了整个天际。
正前方，一道倩影手持长剑，背对自己。
“这里是？”苏命环视四周，心中惊疑不定。
content_en:
Chapter 1: Tower of Death As if waking up from a dream, Su Ming's eyes widened suddenly, and his eyes were scarlet.
In front of him was an antique room, and he was lying on a luxurious bed, with his hands and feet weak and unable to move.
The bed creaked, and two figures were mesmerizing each other. They didn't notice at all that the young man beside him had opened his eyes!
"Am I still alive? Am I dead?"
His name is Su Ming, the first divine emperor of the Chiyang Dynasty. When he went out to explore the mysterious treasure, the Tower of Death, he was accidentally attacked and killed by his best brother Lin Zhan.
The next moment, a memory that did not belong to him suddenly poured into his mind. With the sharp pain that felt like his mind was being torn apart, Su Ming, who had merged his memories, finally understood everything.
He is reborn!
He was reborn in the body of a young man also named Su Ming.
Su Ming, the eldest young master of the Su family in Qianlong City, has been weak since he was a child.
He was paralyzed due to an accident at the age of eighteen. From then on, he lived in seclusion in the backyard. He could only rely on his maids and guards for his daily living.
But the Su family would never have thought that the maids and guards who took care of Su Ming were so bold.
In order to have an affair, the two people who thought the original owner was in the way actually gave the original owner an overdose of drugs, which eventually led to his death.
…
The bed curtains shook, and the man beside him trembled violently, and then he lay on the woman's belly like a shrimp with soft feet.
"Be gentle, you'll wake this loser up later!"
"Baby, what are you afraid of? He has been drugged by us and won't wake up within three or four days. Don't worry."
"You are so bad..."
"But don't you just like me like this?"
"Disgusting!"
Amidst the coquettish words, the two fell asleep leaning on each other...
On the side, Su Ming looked at all this coldly, with indifference in his heart:
"Speaking of it, you and I are both fallen people in the world, but since I borrowed your body to resurrect you, then I will avenge your revenge and my revenge."
He had a plan, but now Su Ming had no ability to take revenge. I can only close my eyes and examine this body.
After a moment, Su Ming shook his head helplessly:
"The body is weak, the meridians are slender, and there are countless impurities in the body. It is no wonder that at the age of twenty, he is still at the first level of the Foundation Establishment Realm."
Tianyuan Continent respects cultivation, and its realms are: Foundation Building, Qi Sea, Golden Pill, Tianmen, Heavenly King, Emperor, Divine Emperor, etc., and each of these realms is divided into nine levels.
Su Ming started practicing at the age of ten, and was only able to reach the first level of foundation building at the age of twenty. You can imagine how slow this speed is.
Su Ming continued to check, but the next moment he frowned:
"What's going on..."
Looking inside, I saw patches of black appearing in the meridians of my legs.
"It's actually poison?"
Su Ming's frown deepened, and he said that no matter how weak the original owner was, he would not suddenly become paralyzed. It turned out to be the cause of poisoning.
However, at this moment, Su Ming had no time to think about who was the real culprit. The top priority was to detoxify first and then practice again.
In this world where the jungle prevails, anything you want to do without cultivation is futile.
At this moment, he suddenly felt a warm current coming from his Dantian.
Wherever the warm current passes, not only the strength of the meridians is strengthened, but even toxins are instantly taken away.
Following the source of the warm current, we saw a small black tower with a simple shape suspended in the Dantian.
"Tower of Death?!"
Su Ming recognized at a glance that the small tower in front of him was the Tower of Death that he encountered before dying in his previous life. But for some unknown reason, the Tower of Death actually reborn with him.
Su Ming was still meditating when a dazzling black light suddenly came from the small black tower in front of him.
The light flickered, and Su Ming felt his mind spin for a while, and then his consciousness appeared in a strange space.
This is a vast sea of ​​​​stars, with countless stars gathering together and densely filling the entire sky.
Directly in front of him, a beautiful figure was holding a long sword and facing away from him.
"Where is this?" Su Ming looked around, feeling shocked and confused.。
